name: extraction
judge_criteria: Compute token-level F1 score between extracted entities/values and the reference. Tokenize on whitespace and punctuation. Score is the F1 value (0.0 to 1.0).

samples.input:
Extract all person names mentioned in this text:

"Dr. Sarah Chen presented her findings alongside Professor James Rodriguez at the annual conference in Geneva. Their colleague Maria Kowalski contributed the statistical analysis."
samples.reference: Sarah Chen, James Rodriguez, Maria Kowalski
